# rintup_monitor (Data Source)

Looks up an existing monitor by exact name (or by id), e.g. to put a monitor managed elsewhere on a status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A monitor created in the panel (or by another team's configuration), found by its exact name.
data "rintup_monitor" "billing" {
  name = "billing.example.com"
}

resource "rintup_status_page" "billing" {
  title      = "Billing Status"
  components = [{ monitor_id = data.rintup_monitor.billing.id }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Monitor id. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact monitor name. It must match exactly one monitor.

### Read-Only

- `interval_seconds` (Number)
- `locations` (Set of String)
- `paused` (Boolean)
- `status` (String) Current status.
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `target` (String) What is checked.
- `type` (String) Monitor type.
